metadata.description: Reusable AI-agent skills for code workflow automation

plugins.name: code-workflow
plugins.description: Code workflow skills: implement, review, refactor, source-analyzer, and github-flow. Includes product discovery, MVP scoping, and development plans with app-service-planning. Adds evidence-based self-verification, durable correction placement, and antipattern gardening.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Monitor every running Claude Code session as a board, whether or not it loads the plugin: lanes for working, needs-you and review, a per-session workflow timeline of prompts, tool calls, subagents and permission prompts, and a detail view with todos, files, context, cost and the linked PR.
